baseline.method: Fresh independent upstream Octave SLPRU, author measured ROI; method reference only

observation_definition: Interior L2 residual / observation L2 after one nonnegative global gain fit alpha=max(0,<Ma,y>/<Ma,Ma>); no spatial alignment.
provenance: Upstream original run; numeric agreement tolerances pre-frozen in private frozen_acceptance.json before extraction. No physical truth available.
objective_definition: Normalize interior digital intensities Y/255 by their global RMS to B (24x784). Minimize generalized KL(B||MU)+.1 nuclear_norm(U)+.1 sum_rows norm(U_row), U>=0. Submitted max-one field represents U up to one nonnegative scalar, profiled analytically as sum(B)/(sum(Ma)+.1*(nuclear_norm(a)+sum_row_norm(a))). Divide total objective by B.size. This is a v2 convex global-field conditional target, not equivalence to the v1 finite reweighted local SLPRU mapping.
objective_bound_provenance: Feasible standard-output objective plus 1e-8 per-datum floating tolerance. Both the unchanged observation error limit and physical output constraints remain mandatory.
